name: MonarchApiKeyRow
title: ApiKeyRow
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.ListItem with androidx.compose.material3.DropdownMenu for the actions and androidx.compose.material3.AlertDialog (ConfirmDialog) for the confirmations; MonarchStatusBadge, MonarchBadge, MonarchTypeToConfirmInput, MonarchInlineErrorRetry; android.text.format.DateUtils for the times
summary: One API key in a list: name and status, the visible prefix with the rest masked, created, last used and expiry times, scopes, and Rotate and Revoke actions that ask for confirmation before calling the app.
whenToUse: In a developer settings screen that lists a workspace's API keys or tokens.
whenNotToUse: To show a new secret once use MonarchKeyCreatedDialog. For a secret the person pastes or edits use MonarchSecretField.
api: @Composable public fun MonarchApiKeyRow(name: String, prefix: String, createdAt: Long, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, lastUsedAt: Long? = null, expiresAt: Long? = null, scopes: List<String> = emptyList(), maxScopes: Int = 3, status: MonarchApiKeyStatus = MonarchApiKeyStatus.Active, now: Long? = null, revokeConfirmPhrase: String? = null, onRotate: (suspend () -> Unit)? = null, onRevoke: (suspend () -> Unit)? = null, menuIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchApiKeyRowLabels = MonarchApiKeyRowLabels(), actions: (@Composable ColumnScope.(close: () -> Unit) -> Unit)? = null)
public enum class MonarchApiKeyStatus { Active, Expiring, Expired, Revoked }

public class MonarchApiKeyRowLabels(prefix: ((prefix: String) -> String)? = null, created: String? = null, lastUsed: String? = null, neverUsed: String? = null, expires: String? = null, scopes: String? = null, noScopes: String? = null, moreScopes: ((count: Int) -> String)? = null, status: ((status: MonarchApiKeyStatus) -> String)? = null, menu: String? = null, actions: ((name: String) -> String)? = null, rotate: String? = null, revoke: String? = null, rotateTitle: ((name: String) -> String)? = null, rotateMessage: String? = null, rotateConfirm: String? = null, revokeTitle: ((name: String) -> String)? = null, revokeMessage: String? = null, revokeConfirm: String? = null, revokePhrasePrompt: ((phrase: String) -> String)? = null, cancel: String? = null, rotating: String? = null, revoking: String? = null, rotateFailed: String? = null, revokeFailed: String? = null)

options.name: name
options.description: The key's name, also used in the confirmations and the menu's spoken name.

options.name: prefix
options.description: The visible, non-secret start of the key; the rest is drawn as a mask.

options.name: createdAt
options.description: When the key was created, in epoch milliseconds, shown as a relative time.

options.name: lastUsedAt
options.description: When the key was last used; without it the row says Never used.

options.name: expiresAt
options.description: When the key expires, if it does.

options.name: scopes
options.description: Scope names, shown as outline badges; without any the row says No scopes.

options.name: maxScopes
options.description: Scopes shown before a +N badge; a negative number shows only the +N badge.

options.name: status
options.description: Active, expiring, expired or revoked; expired and revoked keys have no actions.

options.name: now
options.description: The reference time for relative times; without it they follow the clock, updated every minute.

options.name: revokeConfirmPhrase
options.description: A phrase, usually the name, that must be typed in the revoke dialog before Revoke key works.

options.name: onRotate
options.description: Rotates the key after confirmation. A thrown exception is shown in the row with Try again.

options.name: onRevoke
options.description: Revokes the key after confirmation, like onRotate.

options.name: menuIcon
options.description: Makes the actions button an icon button, such as three dots. Without it the button shows Actions.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string; strings that name something are functions.

options.name: actions
options.description: More menu items after Rotate and Revoke, such as Edit; call close to close the menu.

states.name: active, expiring
states.description: A success or warning status badge and the actions menu.

states.name: expired, revoked
states.description: A neutral or danger status badge and no actions.

states.name: confirming
states.description: Rotate shows an AlertDialog with a primary Rotate key button; Revoke shows one with a danger Revoke key button and, with a phrase, a MonarchTypeToConfirmInput that keeps the button disabled until it matches.

states.name: running
states.description: A small spinner with Rotating… or Revoking…, announced; the menu is disabled.

states.name: failed
states.description: MonarchInlineErrorRetry with the exception's message or the built-in sentence; Try again runs the action again.

appearance: A transparent Material 3 list item: the name in the strong body type with a small status badge, the prefix and mask in the code type and muted text, the times in muted caption text, and outline scope badges. The menu's Revoke item is in the strong danger color. Light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow the theme roles.
platformNotes: The web row shows Rotate and Revoke as buttons and keeps its ConfirmDialog open while the promise runs, showing a rejection inside it. On Android, as on iOS, the actions sit in a trailing menu, as list rows do; the Material 3 AlertDialog closes when a button is tapped, so progress and failures are shown in the row. The web's rotateConfirmOptions and revokeConfirmOptions are replaced by labels, and its separate list of consequences is one revoke message. iOS takes async throwing closures; Android takes suspend functions. Times are epoch milliseconds written with DateUtils.getRelativeTimeSpanString in the language of the app's resources (no java.time below API 26). The web's `as` and link-name options have no meaning on Android. Monarch bundles no icons, so the menu button shows Actions unless menuIcon is given. Android has no destructive menu role: Revoke is drawn in the danger color and its confirmation uses the danger button.
accessibility: The name and the status badge are merged into one element; the status is a word, not only a color.
The prefix is read as "Key starting with sk_live_4f2a"; the mask is not read.
Scopes are one element read as "Scopes" and every scope, including those behind +N.
The menu button is named "Actions for Reporting job" with a 48dp touch target, at the end of the row in both directions.
The confirmation title has heading semantics.
Rotating… or Revoking… is announced through a polite live region when an action starts; the failure is announced by MonarchInlineErrorRetry.
Text wraps at font scale 2.0; the name and status wrap onto two lines when they do not fit.
edgeCases: A long prefix is shortened in the middle, so its start and the mask stay visible.
Only one action runs at a time; the menu is disabled while it runs.
The Revoke key button is disabled until the phrase matches (case-sensitive, ignoring surrounding spaces), and the click checks it again.
A negative maxScopes shows only the +N badge.
The action runs in the row's coroutine scope: if the row leaves the composition, the action is cancelled.

examples.template:
Column {
    MonarchApiKeyRow(
        name = {{keys.0.name}},
        prefix = {{keys.0.prefix}},
        createdAt = {{keys.0.createdAt|millis}},
        lastUsedAt = {{keys.0.lastUsedAt|millis}},
        scopes = listOf({{keys.0.scopes.0}}, {{keys.0.scopes.1}}),
        status = MonarchApiKeyStatus.{{keys.0.status|pascal}},
        now = {{now|millis}},
        onRotate = { delay(200) },
        onRevoke = { delay(200) },
        inlineActions = true,
    )
    MonarchApiKeyRow(
        name = {{keys.1.name}},
        prefix = {{keys.1.prefix}},
        createdAt = {{keys.1.createdAt|millis}},
        expiresAt = {{keys.1.expiresAt|millis}},
        scopes = listOf({{keys.1.scopes.0}}, {{keys.1.scopes.1}}, {{keys.1.scopes.2}}, {{keys.1.scopes.3}}, {{keys.1.scopes.4}}),
        status = MonarchApiKeyStatus.{{keys.1.status|pascal}},
        now = {{now|millis}},
        revokeConfirmPhrase = {{keys.1.revokeConfirmPhrase}},
        onRevoke = { delay(200) },
        inlineActions = true,
    )
}
examples.code:
Column {
    MonarchApiKeyRow(
        name = "Reporting job",
        prefix = "sk_live_4f2a",
        createdAt = 1_777_712_400_000L,
        lastUsedAt = 1_781_087_400_000L,
        scopes = listOf("items:read", "reports:read"),
        status = MonarchApiKeyStatus.Active,
        now = 1_781_092_800_000L,
        onRotate = { delay(200) },
        onRevoke = { delay(200) },
        inlineActions = true,
    )
    MonarchApiKeyRow(
        name = "Import script",
        prefix = "sk_test_91bd",
        createdAt = 1_780_304_400_000L,
        expiresAt = 1_781_427_600_000L,
        scopes = listOf("items:read", "items:write", "users:read", "users:write", "webhooks:write"),
        status = MonarchApiKeyStatus.Expiring,
        now = 1_781_092_800_000L,
        revokeConfirmPhrase = "Import script",
        onRevoke = { delay(200) },
        inlineActions = true,
    )
}

examples.title: An expired key, which has no actions
examples.code:
MonarchApiKeyRow(
    name = "Old CI key",
    prefix = "sk_live_9a01",
    createdAt = now - 400 * DateUtils.DAY_IN_MILLIS,
    expiresAt = now - 5 * DateUtils.DAY_IN_MILLIS,
    status = MonarchApiKeyStatus.Expired,
    now = now,
)
